item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem:
Gita notes that a Moon-linked festival shifts on the Gregorian calendar from year to year, while a solar festival falls on almost the same Gregorian date each year. She considers whether festival dates follow the full Moon, the solar cycle, an extra month added every year for every festival, or a single fixed Gregorian date for every festival.

Why does the solar festival stay on nearly the same Gregorian date?

options.A: It is set by the full Moon each year.
options.B: It follows the solar cycle, which matches the Gregorian calendar closely.
options.C: An extra month is added every year for every festival.
options.D: Every festival is fixed to one Gregorian date.
